name: lessons-learned
description: Learns from your corrections: confirms each one, recalls the lesson when it is relevant again, and turns a repeated correction into a rule CLAUDE.md loads in every session.

model.title: Detector model
model.description: The model that decides whether a prompt is a correction.

ruleCap.title: Rule cap
ruleCap.description: The most rules kept per scope in rules-learned.md. Promoting past it asks which rule goes back to lessons; the candidates are the least-seen rules, then the oldest.

maxRecall.title: Recall limit
maxRecall.description: The most lessons attached to one prompt.
